lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Semi-regular grid of high-luminance circular clusters posterior to the gill slits; notable vertical alignment of 4-5 primary centroids immediately following the pectoral fin insertion point.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of elevated luminance intersecting horizontal spot rows, creating a faint rectilinear grid pattern across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges visible on the upper flank, characterized by sharp specular highlights on the dorsal edge and soft shadowing on the ventral edge.

other_distinctive_markers: High-density clustering of small, uniform high-luminance spots on the dorsal surface of the visible pectoral fin.
